question:
Which of the following letter clusters will replace the question mark (?) and complete the following letter cluster series?

DW, FU, HS, JQ, LO, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

Logic : ​

 
• First letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.​
 
• Pair of the letters are opposite letters according to the English alphabetic series

​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/639597b1634929321e6f1a4354b901607f15f20c671cabf1fcc6eb85276eef20.png] ​

Hence, the correct answer is "NM".
